verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any approval workflow, change-request review, or required sign-off before production feature gate changes go live. The nearby evidence covers other things: SSO/SCIM access management, environment-tier SDK keys, scheduled rollouts, and CLI/Console API automation. These are adjacent controls, not an approval gate, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live
